hallucination.reason: The agent did not state any fact, number, or detail that is not covered by the approved knowledge base.

overclaim.reason: The agent did not guarantee, confirm, or promise anything the approved knowledge base explicitly says must remain indicative or subject to verification.

interruption_recovery.reason: The caller did not interrupt, was not aggressive, and did not derail the conversation, so there was nothing to recover from.

obedience.reason: The agent stayed within its actual role and knowledge base, without inventing services, comparisons, or opinions not in its approved knowledge.

escalation.reason: There were no genuinely out-of-scope requests that required the agent to offer to escalate or transfer.
